segments.text: ALmightie God, whiche doeſte ſee that we haue no power of our ſelues to helpe our ſelues: kepe thou vs both outwardelye in our bodyes, and inwardelye in our ſoules, that we may be defended from all aduerſityes whiche may happen to the bodye, and from all euyll thoughtes whiche may aſſault and hurt the ſoule: through Ieſus Chriſt. &c.
